tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun rig bsnyen pa'i sbyin sreg la cho ga dang bzlas grangs phral tshul bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i kun rig bsnyen thabs sbyin sreg dang bcas pa'i yi ge ma nor don gsal las/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gsum gyi dbang du mdzad nas sbyin sreg gi skabs bla ma gong ma'i phyag len ltar/ nyin gsum gyi gnyis pa la cho ga tshar gnyis re dang / grol nyin gcig ste lnga mdzad nas/ cho ga rer rtsa rig drug brgya tsho bcu la 'bul tshan re mdzad cing / de dag kyang rtsa rig kho nas 'bul bar gsungs pas nyin mtshan kha sbyor lta bur sems kyis lcogs kyang lce'i sngags sgra ma dag pa sogs lus dub nyams kyis cho ga ma dag pa'i nyes pa bsrung phyir 'dir zhugs brgyad la cho ga tshar bco lnga bgyid rgyur gcig nas bdun gyi bar thun gnyis re/ brgyad par thun gcig bcas la cho ga rer rtsa rig nyis brgya re'i mtshams su 'bul tshan bya zhing / rdzas sngags ni/ oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ kho na'i phul mthar spel tshig sbyar/ rdzas sngags de ltar rung ba yang / thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i kun rig gi sbyin sreg ro sreg dang bcas pa'i yi ge las/ de nas gtso bo la rtsa rig gam/ bskyed sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bsreg rdzas rnams phul/ sreg rdzas sde tshan re re'i mthar spel tshig gong ltar brjod/ ces gsungs pas shes so/ /zhes kun rig bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi gsal byed nyung ngu 'di yang dpal sa skya'i bde chen gling pa kun dga' nor bu'i kun rig gi bsnyen pa bgyis tshe sbyin sreg gi cho ga dag pa'i phyir so skye'i blos lcogs tsam gyis cho ga dang sngags grangs phral lugs shig dgos zhes zur 'chang chos rje rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis dngos su brgyud du bskul bar brten/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis bkod pa 'dis kun rig gi bsnyen pa sbyin sreg dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas nas sems can thams cad ngan song las grol ba'i rgyur gyur cig
